lead: Zaheer Khan is an Indian cricketer, born on 7 October 1978 in Shrirampur.
As of 2026, he is 47 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Baroda cricket team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
